# OpenJCockpit Docs

> Documentation for OpenJCockpit, an open-source AI Software Factory for governed, spec-driven software development with teams of AI agents, OPA policy checks, human approval gates and reviewable Git delivery.

## Learn

- [What is OpenJCockpit?](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/intro): five-minute introduction
- [Quickstart](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/getting-started/quickstart): run the stack locally with Docker Compose and Ollama
- [Troubleshooting](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/getting-started/troubleshooting): common start-up and first-run problems

## Tutorials

- [Your first spec-driven change](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/tutorials/first-spec-driven-change)
- [Approval gates](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/tutorials/approval-gates)
- [Policy as code with OPA](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/tutorials/policy-as-code)
- [Build a custom agent](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/tutorials/custom-agent)
- [Bring your own model](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/tutorials/bring-your-own-model)

## Concepts

- [Why agents never see your Git credentials](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/concepts/credential-isolation)
- [Glossary](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/learn/concepts/glossary)

## Reference

- [Product reference](https://openjcockpit.github.io/OpenJCockpit-docs/reference): the concise reference for installing, operating and governing OpenJCockpit
